## Summary

Mike Camara builds, modernises and ships production mobile apps across React Native, Expo, native iOS and Android. He currently leads mobile platform and delivery practices at Flight Centre Travel Group (Flight Centre, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout, World360 Rewards). Previously he built React Native, cloud and IoT capabilities at VBreathe. Independently he publishes consumer apps across health, fitness, family, learning and productivity under 7X AI Engineering.

## Core expertise

- React Native and Expo (EAS, migrations, native modules, monorepos)
- Native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin)
- Mobile CI/CD and release engineering (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Fastlane, EAS)
- Mobile testing and observability (Maestro, Appium, Sentry, New Relic)
- AI-assisted engineering and AI-powered mobile product features
